mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 showed a sustained decline for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% in a month signals a deflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 10% in a month signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased construction activity supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 10% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls and a decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased employment supports consumer spending and economic growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced consumer spending anticipates a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% within a month.
